由于我正在埋头为大家准备下一个版本，因此响应有所延迟 - 一旦发布，响应将恢复正常！

v1.2.1 现已推出！ - 需要通过 ComfyUI 管理器更新 DaxNodes

  • FLF2V 添加了 GGUF 支持 - 无需新模型

  • 修复了独立禁用/启用放大和插值的能力

  • 专用分辨率选择器节点，添加了从 v1.3.1 到 I2V 和 FLF2V 的自动调整大小功能


DaxNodes 现在可通过 ComfyUI Manager 使用，不再需要 git 克隆！

当前跟踪的错误：

  • KJNodes Get / Set 报告某些用户丢失错误，如果发生这种情况 - 确保您从 ComfyUI 管理器下载最新版本的 DaxNodes，然后重新导入工作流程！ - 进行中

如果您看到“FileNotFoundError（[WinError 2]系统找不到指定的文件。）“从视频保存或其他视频相关节点, FFmpeg 丢失或不在您的系统路径中。

  • 设置（需要完整版本）：

  • 下载满FFmpeg 构建

  • 将其解压缩到稳定位置（例如 C:\ffmpeg）。

  • 将 C:\ffmpeg\bin 添加到系统路径：

  • 打开编辑系统环境变量 -> 环境变量....

  • 在系统变量下，选择路径 -> 编辑...。

  • 单击新建并添加 C:\ffmpeg\bin。

  • 保存并退出。

重启ComfyUI（以及您的终端/命令提示符）。

在此之后，一切都应该正常！

v1.3.1 特点

基于分段的提示

  • 持续的积极提示：在整个视频中保持一致的细节（即“一个有着绿色眼睛和棕色头发的女人在她温暖的卧室里”）。

  • 分段积极提示：用+分隔，每段长度一个（即“她正在写日记+她合上日记并站起来+她走开”）。

  • 使您能够更好地控制长视频，并有助于减少 WAN 在 I2V 启动时呈现奇怪的摄像机移动或抖动的趋势。

无尽式循环

  • 段可以“无限”链接（我将节点上限设置为 9999），有效创建 无休止的循环。

  • 的视频执行ID管理覆盖和拼接 - 只需在生成新序列时增加 ID。

流媒体 RIFE VFI + 升级

  • 调整过RIFE VFI现在正在升级流帧而不是将整个序列保存在 VRAM/RAM 中。

  • 允许更长的视频、更平滑的插值和更清晰的升级，而不会出现 OOM 错误。

人脸检测和漂移校正

  • 智能Mediapipe人脸框检测锁专注于字符。

  • 漂移校正确保最终视频运行至少按照要求- 但它不会削减中期生成，而是会添加完整的额外片段，直到达到或超过目标帧数。

  • 这样，就不会浪费生成的帧，并且您始终会得到平滑、完整的片段。

  • 完全可切换，具有可调节的帧回顾设置。

分辨率处理

  • T2V：标准 WAN 分辨率预设，具有可选覆盖。

  • I2V：输入图像缩放至 WAN 原生分辨率，保留纵横比。支持“本机”直通。

生活质量与管理

  • 独立切换放大/插值。

  • 按执行 ID 组织的临时文件输出 - 清除/输出/.tmp/定期以节省空间。

展望未来

该工作流程仍处于实验阶段，未来的版本将扩展分段控制、更智能地处理运动/摄像机行为、更自适应的面部跟踪，甚至集成电影序列的音频/视频。大事即将来临！

注释

我已尽力将您想要配置的大多数节点（大致）按顺序放置在流程的下部，而大多数操作/后端内容位于顶部。节点已根据其功能尽可能清晰地标记。

除此之外；

  • NAG Attention 正在使用，因此建议将 CFG 设置为 1。

  • 采样器和调度器默认设置为 uni_pc // simple，因为我发现这是速度和质量的最佳平衡。 (1.1> 仅）如果您不介意等待（根据我的经验，等待很多时间）更长的时间以获得稍微更好的结果，那么我建议使用 RES4LYF 自定义节点中的 res_3s // bong_tangent 。

  • 我已将默认步数设置为 8（每个采样器 4 个步），而不是 4，因为这是我看到最重要的质量/时间权衡的地方 - 但这实际上取决于您的偏好。

  • 默认情况下，此流程会将完成的视频保存到 ComfyUI/output/WAN//。

I2V

  • 自定义节点flow2-wan-视频会与Wan image to video节点产生冲突，必须删除才能工作。我发现通过 ComfyUI 管理器删除时，该节点并未从 custom_nodes 文件夹中完全删除，因此必须手动删除。

GGUF

  • 与 GGUF 版本流程一起使用的所有模型都是相同的除基本高噪声和低噪声模型外。您需要确定哪个 GGUF 定量最适合您的系统，然后在每个相应的 Load WAN 2.2 GGUF 节点中相应地设置正确的模型。根据经验，理想情况下，您的 GGUF 模型应该适合您的 VRAM，并有几 GB 的空闲空间。

  • GGUF 流的示例是使用 WAN 2.2 I2V 和 T2V 的 Q6_K 数量创建的。

  • 使用此流程测试的 WAN 2.2 GGUF 量化来自 Huggingface 上的以下位置；

    • T2V

      • 高噪音

      • 低噪音

    • I2V

      • 高噪音

      • 低噪音

多媒体音频

  • 要设置 MMAUDIO，您必须下载下面的 MMAUDIO 模型，在模型目录 (ComfyUI/models/mmaudio) 中创建一个“mmaudio”文件夹，并将下载的每个 mmaudio 模型放入此文件夹中（甚至 apple_DFN5B-CLIP-ViT-H-14-384_fp16.safetensors）。

区块交换流量

  • 已停止使用，因为我发现本机 ComfyUI 内存交换可以节省更多内存，并且在我的测试中减慢进程速度。如果您在基本 v1.2 流程中收到 OOM，我建议您尝试 GGUF 版本！

Triton 和 SageAttention 问题

  • 我看到用户遇到的最常见问题与 Triton 和 SageAttention 的安装有关 - 虽然我很乐意尽我所能提供帮助，但我只是一个人，无法总是在合理的时间内帮助每个人。幸运的是，@CRAZYAI4U 给我指出了稳定性矩阵它可以自动部署 ComfyUI，并有一个用于安装 Triton 和 SageAttention 的专用脚本。

  • 您首先需要从他们的存储库下载 Stability Matrix，然后通过他们的中心下载 ComfyUI。通过中心部署 ComfyUI 后，单击 ComfyUI 实例条目左上角的三个水平点，选择“Package Commands”，然后选择“Install Triton and SageAttention”。完成后，您应该能够导入流程，通过 ComfyUI 管理器安装任何缺少的依赖项，放入模型并开始生成！

  • 很快就会发布一篇专门的文章，其中包含有关此问题的屏幕截图。

v1.2.1 Out Now! - Update to DaxNodes via ComfyUI manager required

  • FLF2V added with GGUF support - no new models required

  • Fixed ability to independently disabled / enable upscaling and interpolation

  • Dedicated resolution picker nodes, added auto-resizing functionality from v1.3.1 to I2V and FLF2V


DaxNodes now available via ComfyUI Manager, no more git clone required!

Current Tracked Bugs:

  • KJNodes Get / Set reporting a missing error for some users, if this happens - ensure you download the latest version of DaxNodes from ComfyUI manager, and re-import the workflow! - In progress

If you see a "FileNotFoundError ([WinError 2] The system cannot find the file specified.)" fromVideoSaveorother video-related nodes, FFmpeg is missing or not in your system PATH.

  • Setup (Full Version Required):

  • Download thefullFFmpeg build

  • Extract it to a stable location (e.g., C:\ffmpeg).

  • Add C:\ffmpeg\bin to your system PATH:

  • Open Edit the system environment variables -> Environment Variables....

  • Under System variables, select Path -> Edit....

  • Click New and add C:\ffmpeg\bin.

  • Save and exit.

Restart ComfyUI(and your terminal/command prompt).

After this, everything should work!

v1.3.1 Features

Segment-Based Prompting

  • Persistent Positive Prompt: Keeps consistent details across the entire video (ie. “A woman with green eyes and brown hair in her warmly lit bedroom”).

  • Segment Positive Prompts: Separated with +, one per segment length (ie. “She is writing in a journal + She closes the journal and stands up + She walks away”).

  • Gives you far more control in long-form videos and helps reduce WAN’s tendency to render weird camera movements or jutters on I2V start.

Endless-Style Looping

  • Segments can chain "infinitely"(I capped the node at 9999), creating effectively endless loops.

  • TheVideo Execution IDmanages overwrites and stitching - just increment the ID as you generate new sequences.

Streaming RIFE VFI + Upscaling

  • TweakedRIFE VFIand upscaling nowstream framesinstead of holding entire sequences in VRAM/RAM.

  • Allows much longer videos, smoother interpolation, and sharper upscales without OOM errors.

Face Detection & Drift Correction

  • Intelligent Mediapipe face frame detectionlocks focus on characters.

  • Drift correctionensures the final video runsat least as long as requested- but instead of cutting mid-generation, it will add full extra segments until the target framecount is met or exceeded.

  • This way, no generated frames are wasted, and you always end up with smooth, complete segments.

  • Fully toggleable, with adjustable frame look-back settings.

Resolution Handling

  • T2V: Standard WAN resolution presets with optional overrides.

  • I2V: Input image scales to WAN-native resolutions, preserving aspect ratio. “Native” passthrough supported.

QoL & Management

  • Toggle upscaling/interpolation independently.

  • Temp file output organized by execution ID - clear/output/.tmp/periodically to save space.

Looking Ahead

This workflow is still experimental , future versions will expand on segment control, smarter handling of motion/camera behavior, more adaptive face tracking, and even integration of audio/video for cinematic sequences. Big things are coming!

Notes

I've done my best to place most nodes that you'd want to configure at the lower portion of the flow (roughly) sequentially, while most of the operational / backend stuff sits at the top. Nodes have been labeled according to their function as clearly as possible.

Beyond that;

  • NAG Attention is in use, so it is recommended to leave the CFG set to 1.

  • The sampler and scheduler are set to uni_pc // simple by default as I find this is the best balance of speed and quality. (1.1> Only) If you don't mind waiting (a lot, in my experience) longer for some slightly better results, then I'd recommend res_3s // bong_tangent from the RES4LYF custom node.

  • I have set the default number of steps to 8 (4 steps per sampler) as opposed to 4, as here is where I see the most significant quality / time tradeoff - but this is really up to your preference.

  • This flow will save finished videos to ComfyUI/output/WAN/<T2V|T2I|I2V>/ by default.

I2V

  • The custom nodeflow2-wan-videowill cause a conflict with the Wan image to video node and must be removed to work. I have found that this node does not get completely removed from the custom_nodes folder when removing via the ComfyUI manager, so this must be deleted manually.

GGUF

  • All models used with the GGUF versions of the flows are the samewith the exception of the base high and low noise model. You will need to determine which GGUF quant best fits your system, and then set the correct model in each respective Load WAN 2.2 GGUF node accordingly. As a rule of thumb, ideally your GGUF model should fit within your VRAM with a few GB to spare.

  • The examples for the GGUF flows were created using the Q6_K quant of WAN 2.2 I2V and T2V.

  • The WAN 2.2 GGUF quants tested with this flow come from the following locations on huggingface;

    • T2V

      • High Noise

      • Low Noise

    • I2V

      • High Noise

      • Low Noise

MMAUDIO

  • To set up MMAUDIO, you must download the MMAUDIO models below, create an "mmaudio" folder in your models directory (ComfyUI/models/mmaudio), and place every mmaudio model downloaded into this folder (even apple_DFN5B-CLIP-ViT-H-14-384_fp16.safetensors).

Block Swap Flows

  • Being discontinued as I have found that the native ComfyUI memory swapping conserves more memory and slows down the process less in my testing. If you receive OOM with the base v1.2 flows, I'd recommend trying out the GGUF versions!

Triton and SageAttention Issues

  • The most frequent issues I see users encounter are related to the installation of Triton and SageAttention - and while I'm happy to help out as much as I can, I am but one man and can't always get to everyone in a reasonable time. Luckily, @CRAZYAI4U has pointed me toStability Matrixwhich can auto-deploy ComfyUI and has a dedicated script for installing Triton and SageAttention.

  • You will first need to download Stability Matrix from their repository, and download ComfyUI via their hub. Once ComfyUI has been deployed via the hub, click the three horizontal dots to the top left of the ComfyUI instance's entry, select "Package Commands" and then "Install Triton and SageAttention". Once complete, you should be able to import the flow, install any missing dependencies via ComfyUI manager, drop in your models and start generating!

  • Will spin up a dedicated article with screenshots on this soon.
